ar.title: سمك مقلي سيادية
ar.intro: سمك مقلي كلاسيكي بأرز بصل بني.

steps.n1: قطّع السمك إلى قطع ناضرة واقليها وصفِّها على ورق ممص.
steps.n2: اقلِ البصل بنفس الزيت حتى يصبح بنياً غامقاً.
steps.n3: أضف الأرز والماء مع الملح واطهِ بدون غطاء حتى يمتص الماء.
steps.n4: ضع السمك المقلي في الأعلى على الأرز، أبعد الحرارة إلى الحد الأدنى، غطِّ واطهِ لمدة 15–20 دقيقة.

en.title: Fried Fish Sayadiya (Sayadiyit Samak Ma’li)
en.intro: Recipe 164, page 75 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Cut the fish into neat pieces, fry them and drain on absorbent paper.
steps.n2: Fry the onion in the same oil until deep brown.
steps.n3: Add the rice and water with salt and cook uncovered until the water has been absorbed.
steps.n4: Lay the fried fish on top of the rice, turn the heat to its lowest, cover and cook for 15–20 minutes.
steps.n5: Serve the fish on its rice.

legacySteps: Cut the fish into neat pieces, fry them and drain on absorbent paper.
Fry the onion in the same oil until deep brown.
Add the rice and water with salt and cook uncovered until the water has been absorbed.
Lay the fried fish on top of the rice, turn the heat to its lowest, cover and cook for 15–20 minutes.
Serve the fish on its rice.
